 Opinion Why Phoenix is resuming water-service disconnections
 Council member: City also offering SNAP guidance
 Councilwoman Ann O'Brien 
 Submitted photo/City of Phoenix 
 OPINION — Beginning Nov. 1, Phoenix will resume water-service disconnections for customers with seriously delinquent city-services accounts.
 Water shutoffs were suspended during the COVID-19 pandemic and delinquent balances have continued to grow. More than 9,000 accounts currently carry nearly $24 million in past-due balances for water, wastewater and trash services.
 Collecting these payments helps maintain the financial stability of our water utility.
